title: One reaper per cluster
description: Every worker looks for dead workers four times a second, so the pg_locks scans grow with the number of workers. JS-084 made liveness one state machine; the reaping remains per worker.
acceptanceCriteria: With 50 workers, the count of pg_locks scans per second is constant in the number of workers (statements counted with a tracer)
The existing kill and outage tests pass with their bounds unchanged
ARCHITECTURE.md states one reaper per cluster and how it is chosen
notes: Done by JS-030 (#191): one reaper per cluster, with pg_locks statements counted flat at 60 workers and the docs updated.
